notes: City of Laredo, TX (Webb County), within city limits. PROVISIONAL: built from the City of Laredo's public parcel layer, which predates some recent subdivisions; about 13% of the city's taxable land (mostly newer industrial parks and subdivisions in north Laredo, and large unplatted tracts) has no polygon yet. Built by data/jurisidictions/run_laredo.py (webb_county.py, shared runner tx_multicounty.py). 72,382 parcels, $9.48B land. All values 2026.

Values: Webb County Appraisal District's 2026 certified export (PACS 8.0.33, exported 2026-08-06; downloaded by hand). Geometry: the City of Laredo's public parcel layer (PARCEL_LANDUSE_ST_CODES, 78,803 polygons) joined on Webb CAD's geo number; 99% of its polygons match a certified record. Check: Webb CAD's taxable land on City of Laredo accounts (C1) is $10.90B vs $9.48B mapped here.
City limits: Census TIGER/Line 2025 place 4841464; the City of Laredo entity (C1) agrees on all but 53 / 19 accounts.
Exempt land dropped: the roll's EX flags (EX-XV etc.; every named public owner carries one): 2,701 records. 205 utility records left off.
Condos and undivided interests: 1,613 undivided-interest groups summed; 3,121 condo / townhome units in 217 developments merged onto their land.
Land size: on 570 parcels the polygon is a fragment of the roll's acreage and the appraiser's area is used; 188 slivers hidden.
Singularity sweep: 48 of 72,382 parcels, all at most 7x the neighbourhood or hidden slivers; 2 condo units (Plantation Square II, Brooklyn Condominiums) at 4.6-6.6x.
Under 100k parcels: browser GeoParquet path, no PMTiles bake.

Parking is OSM delivered through Overture Maps (release 2026-10-21.0, --overture-only), classified surface vs structure: 169 lots, 82.7 acres, $35.3M est. land value. OSM parking coverage in Laredo is thin, so this undercounts. apply_parking_category.py tagged 24 parcels 'Parking Lot'.
Links: Webb CAD's property page pinned to 2026 (webbcad.org/property-detail/<prop_id>/2026; confirmed by the user).
